generic.Defined scope/population: All open vulnerabilities on the resilience register awaiting an impact tolerance assessment.
generic.In-scope period: Current resilience assessment cycle for all in-scope important business services.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each vulnerability record shows scenario assumptions, tolerance score and breach flag.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of scored vulnerabilities matches the open vulnerability register total.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scoring assumptions and scenario parameters are dated and saved on the record in Archer GRC.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Vulnerabilities routed to the Lead for prioritisation are logged with routing date.
generic.Test population: Sample of vulnerabilities flagged as tolerance breaches in the current cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if every breach vulnerability has a score, rationale and Lead routing recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Unscored or disputed vulnerabilities escalate to the Operational Resilience Lead.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment is complete only when every open vulnerability has a score and breach flag.
generic.Evidence location: Resilience vulnerability register in Archer GRC.

steps.title: Open the resilience vulnerability register in Archer GRC
sop: Log into Archer GRC and navigate to the resilience vulnerability register module.
Filter the register to vulnerabilities without a recorded impact tolerance score.
Done when the unscored vulnerability list is displayed.
verify: Check the filtered list against the register's total open vulnerability count.
Pass when the unscored list matches the expected open population.

steps.title: Score each vulnerability against the impact tolerance metric
sop: Open each vulnerability record and review the linked business service's approved impact tolerance metric.
Score projected disruption duration, data loss, financial and customer harm against the threshold.
Enter the numeric score into the vulnerability record's assessment field.
Done when every vulnerability in the sample carries a tolerance score.
verify: Recalculate one score independently from the scenario inputs.
Pass when the recalculated score matches the recorded score.

steps.title: Flag tolerance-breach vulnerabilities in the register
sop: Compare each scored vulnerability to its service's tolerance threshold.
Set the breach flag to Yes for any vulnerability projected to exceed the threshold.
Done when every scored vulnerability shows a breach flag value.
verify: Spot-check a flagged and an unflagged vulnerability against the threshold math.
Pass when the flag value matches the threshold comparison.

steps.title: Record assumptions and scenario parameters against the record
sop: Enter the scenario parameters and assumptions used for the assessment into the vulnerability record.
Save the entry with the assessment date.
Done when assumptions are saved and timestamped on the record.
verify: Open the record and confirm the assumptions field is populated and dated.
Pass when assumptions and a timestamp are both present.

steps.title: Attach the breach rationale to the business service entry
sop: Draft a short rationale explaining why the vulnerability breaches the impact tolerance.
Attach the rationale to the corresponding important business service entry in Archer GRC.
Done when the rationale is linked to the business service record.
verify: Open the business service entry and confirm the rationale attachment is visible.
Pass when the rationale is attached and readable.

steps.title: Route tolerance-breach vulnerabilities to the Operational Resilience Lead
sop: Select all vulnerabilities flagged as tolerance breaches in the current cycle.
Send the routing notification to the Operational Resilience Lead via the Archer GRC workflow.
Done when every breach vulnerability shows a routed-for-review status.
verify: Check the workflow log for a routing action against each breach vulnerability.
Pass when all breach vulnerabilities show a routed status and recipient.

steps.title: Confirm receipt and prioritisation queue placement
sop: Open the routed vulnerability queue in Archer GRC.
Confirm each routed vulnerability appears with its score, flag and rationale intact.
Done when the Lead confirms the queue is complete and accurate.
verify: Cross-check the queue count against the number of breach vulnerabilities routed.
Pass when the queue count matches the routed count exactly.

generic.Defined scope/population: All tolerance-breach vulnerabilities in the register requiring a remediation investment plan.
generic.In-scope period: Current remediation planning cycle following vulnerability prioritisation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each remediation plan names an action owner, target completion date and estimated cost.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of drafted remediation plans matches the number of tolerance-breach vulnerabilities.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Remediation plan documents are version-dated in SharePoint and linked in Archer GRC.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Vulnerabilities without a feasible remediation option are logged with the blocking reason.
generic.Test population: Sample of tolerance-breach vulnerabilities from the current remediation cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if every breach vulnerability has a costed plan with owner and date.
generic.Exception handling path: Infeasible or unresourced plans route to the Business Continuity Manager for review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Planning is complete only when every breach vulnerability has an approved-for-review plan.
generic.Evidence location: Remediation plan documents in SharePoint, referenced from Archer GRC.

steps.title: Pull the list of tolerance-breach vulnerabilities from Archer GRC
sop: Open the vulnerability register in Archer GRC and filter to tolerance-breach status.
Export the filtered list for remediation planning.
Done when the tolerance-breach list is confirmed against the register.
verify: Compare the exported count to the register's breach-flag filter count.
Pass when the two counts match exactly.

steps.title: Draft a remediation plan for each tolerance-breach vulnerability
sop: Create a remediation plan document in SharePoint for each breach vulnerability.
Name the accountable action owner, target completion date and estimated cost.
Done when a draft plan exists for every breach vulnerability.
verify: Open a sample plan and confirm owner, date and cost fields are filled.
Pass when all three fields are present and readable.

steps.title: Size the investment ask for each remediation option
sop: Estimate headcount, capex and vendor spend required for each remediation option.
Enter the sized investment ask into the vulnerability register entry.
Done when every plan carries a sized investment estimate.
verify: Recheck one sized estimate against its underlying cost inputs.
Pass when the estimate reconciles to the inputs used.

steps.title: Sequence remediation actions by severity and dependency
sop: Order the draft remediation plans by tolerance-breach severity tier.
Adjust the sequence for any technical or resourcing dependencies between actions.
Done when the sequenced remediation order is saved.
verify: Confirm the highest-severity breaches appear first in the sequence.
Pass when severity ordering is correct with dependencies respected.

steps.title: Record the remediation plan reference in Archer GRC
sop: Copy the SharePoint document link for each remediation plan.
Paste the reference into the corresponding vulnerability record in Archer GRC.
Done when every vulnerability record links to its remediation plan document.
verify: Click through a sample link from Archer GRC to confirm it opens the correct plan.
Pass when the linked document matches the vulnerability record.

steps.title: Circulate the draft plan to the Business Continuity Manager
sop: Send the draft remediation investment plan to the Business Continuity Manager via SharePoint sharing.
Request feasibility review before submission for approval.
Done when the plan is shared and a review request is logged.
verify: Check the SharePoint share log for the review request.
Pass when the share and request are both recorded with a date.

steps.title: Complete feasibility review and record findings
sop: Review each draft plan for resourcing and delivery feasibility.
Record approval, rejection or requested changes against the plan document.
Done when every draft plan carries a feasibility review outcome.
verify: Confirm each plan document shows a reviewer name and outcome.
Pass when all circulated plans have a recorded feasibility outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: All vulnerabilities pending validation sign-off from their assigned management lead.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each vulnerability entry shows a management lead sign-off or a logged dispute.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of validated entries matches the number of vulnerabilities scheduled for review.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sign-off or dispute comments are timestamped against the register entry in Archer GRC.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Disputed findings are logged with the lead's rationale and routed for resolution.
generic.Test population: Sample of vulnerability entries due for management lead validation this cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if every entry shows a sign-off or a logged dispute with rationale.
generic.Exception handling path: Outstanding validations past the review window are chased to closure.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validation is complete only when every entry has sign-off or disposition recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Vulnerability register in Archer GRC with session notes in SharePoint.

steps.title: Schedule validation review sessions with management leads
sop: Identify the business unit, technology and third-party leads named as owners on each vulnerability.
Send meeting invites for validation review sessions to each lead.
Done when sessions are scheduled with all named leads.
verify: Check the calendar for confirmed sessions against the list of named leads.
Pass when every lead has an accepted or scheduled session.

steps.title: Walk each lead through their assigned vulnerability entries
sop: Present each vulnerability entry assigned to the lead during the session.
Capture the lead's sign-off or dispute directly in the register.
Done when every presented entry shows a sign-off or dispute value.
verify: Review the register after the session for a recorded outcome per entry.
Pass when every discussed entry has sign-off or dispute recorded.

steps.title: Record disputed findings and rationale in the register
sop: Capture the lead's stated reason for disputing a finding.
Enter the dispute and rationale as a comment on the register entry.
Done when every dispute has a recorded rationale comment.
verify: Open a disputed entry and confirm the rationale comment is present.
Pass when the rationale explains the basis for the dispute.

steps.title: Update the vulnerability owner field once accountability is confirmed
sop: Confirm which lead has accepted accountability for the vulnerability.
Update the owner field on the register entry to that lead's name.
Done when the owner field reflects the confirmed accountable lead.
verify: Cross-check the owner field against the session sign-off notes.
Pass when the recorded owner matches the confirming lead.

steps.title: Chase outstanding validations to closure
sop: Identify vulnerabilities still awaiting sign-off past the agreed review window.
Send a follow-up reminder to the responsible lead via SharePoint or email.
Done when every outstanding validation has a follow-up logged.
verify: Check the register for a follow-up date against each outstanding entry.
Pass when no entry is outstanding without a logged follow-up.

steps.title: Close out the validation cycle in the register
sop: Confirm every entry now carries a sign-off or a resolved dispute.
Mark the validation cycle as complete in Archer GRC.
Done when the cycle status is set to complete.
verify: Count entries lacking sign-off or dispute before closing the cycle.
Pass when zero entries remain without a recorded outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: All remediation actions that have missed their committed milestone by more than the escalation threshold.
generic.In-scope period: Current month's Board Risk Committee reporting cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Escalation paper names the overdue remediation, root cause, revised date and residual exposure.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of escalated remediations matches the number flagged overdue beyond threshold.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation paper is version-dated and filed in the board portal pack.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Remediations not escalated despite being overdue are logged with the reason held back.
generic.Test population: Sample of remediation actions overdue beyond the escalation threshold this cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if every overdue remediation past threshold has an escalation paper filed.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed root cause or date estimates route back to the action owner before filing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Escalation is complete only when the Committee decision is recorded against the action.
generic.Evidence location: Board Risk Committee pack in the board portal, decision logged in Archer GRC.

steps.title: Identify remediation actions overdue beyond the escalation threshold
sop: Open the remediation tracker in Archer GRC and filter to overdue actions.
Compare each overdue action's days-late figure against the defined escalation threshold.
Done when the list of threshold-breaching remediations is confirmed.
verify: Recheck one action's days-late calculation against its milestone date.
Pass when the calculation matches the filtered result.

steps.title: Draft the delay escalation paper for each overdue remediation
sop: Name the overdue remediation, root cause and revised completion date in the paper.
State the residual risk exposure created by the delay.
Done when a draft escalation paper exists for every threshold-breaching action.
verify: Review a draft paper for all four required fields.
Pass when root cause, revised date and exposure are all present.

steps.title: Attach the escalation paper to the Board Risk Committee pack
sop: Log into the board portal and open the upcoming Committee meeting pack.
Upload the escalation paper ahead of the scheduled meeting cutoff.
Done when the paper appears in the published meeting pack.
verify: Open the board portal pack and confirm the paper is listed.
Pass when the escalation paper is visible in the pack before the meeting.

steps.title: Present the escalation and capture the Committee decision
sop: Present the escalation paper's root cause and exposure to the Committee.
Note the Committee's decision to accept delay, demand acceleration, or reassign owner.
Done when a decision is recorded for the meeting.
verify: Check the meeting minutes for a recorded decision against the escalation item.
Pass when the decision matches one of the three defined outcomes.

steps.title: Record the Committee decision against the remediation action
sop: Enter the Committee's decision into the remediation action record in Archer GRC.
Note any conditions attached to the decision.
Done when the decision is saved on the remediation record.
verify: Open the remediation record and confirm the decision field is populated.
Pass when the recorded decision matches the meeting minutes.

steps.title: Update the remediation status and revised milestone
sop: Set the remediation action's status to reflect the Committee outcome.
Enter the revised milestone date if acceleration or a new date was agreed.
Done when status and revised date are both updated.
verify: Compare the updated milestone date to the Committee's agreed date.
Pass when the recorded date matches what the Committee approved.

steps.title: Confirm Enterprise Risk Manager awareness of the outcome
sop: Review the updated remediation record and Committee decision.
Confirm the residual risk exposure is reflected in the enterprise risk view.
Done when the Enterprise Risk Manager confirms the record is current.
verify: Cross-check the enterprise risk view against the remediation record.
Pass when the two are consistent for this action.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full resilience investment and remediation plan across all prioritised vulnerabilities.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Investment plan package shows total cost, prioritised vulnerability list and tolerance impact.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Prioritised vulnerability count in the package matches the register's ranked list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval decision, conditions and date are filed as a version-dated record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected or conditionally approved items are logged with the condition to close out.
generic.Test population: The current cycle's resilience investment plan submission.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if the plan carries a CRO decision, date and any conditions recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved budget disputes route back to the Operational Resilience Lead before resubmission.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approval is complete only when the signed decision is filed against the register.
generic.Evidence location: Signed approval record in Archer GRC, package filed in the board portal.

steps.title: Package the remediation investment plan for sign-off
sop: Compile the total cost, prioritised vulnerability list and expected tolerance impact.
Assemble the package into a single submission document.
Done when the package is complete and ready for routing.
verify: Check the package for all three required components.
Pass when cost, vulnerability list and tolerance impact are all present.

steps.title: Route the investment plan to the Chief Risk Officer for approval
sop: Open the GRC platform's approval workflow for the investment plan.
Submit the package to the Chief Risk Officer for decision.
Done when the workflow shows the plan pending CRO approval.
verify: Check the workflow status for the pending-approval state.
Pass when the CRO is shown as the assigned approver.

steps.title: Review and decide on the investment plan
sop: Review the packaged cost, vulnerability list and tolerance impact.
Approve, reject or approve with conditions in the GRC workflow.
Done when a decision is recorded in the workflow.
verify: Open the workflow and confirm a decision status is set.
Pass when the decision is one of approve, reject or conditional.

steps.title: Capture the approver's decision, conditions and date
sop: Record the CRO's decision, any conditions and the approval date on the plan record.
Save the record in Archer GRC.
Done when decision, conditions and date are all captured.
verify: Open the plan record and confirm all three fields are populated.
Pass when the recorded date matches the workflow decision timestamp.

steps.title: Record approved budget adjustments
sop: Compare the approved budget to the original remediation cost estimate.
Log any adjustment amount and reason against the cost estimate.
Done when the adjustment is recorded or marked not applicable.
verify: Recalculate the adjustment from approved versus original figures.
Pass when the recorded adjustment matches the recalculation.

steps.title: File the signed approval as supporting evidence
sop: Attach the signed approval record to the resilience vulnerability register.
Confirm the attachment is linked from the register's summary view.
Done when the signed record is filed and linked.
verify: Open the register summary and confirm the approval attachment opens correctly.
Pass when the filed record matches the signed approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open vulnerabilities on the register requiring a likelihood and severity score.
generic.In-scope period: Current risk-scoring cycle prior to remediation planning.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every open vulnerability carries a likelihood score, severity score and priority tier.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scored vulnerability count matches the total open vulnerability register population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scoring matrix version and scoring date are recorded against each vulnerability.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Material rating changes versus the prior period are flagged and logged with reason.
generic.Test population: Sample of open vulnerabilities scored in the current cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if every vulnerability has a likelihood score, severity score and tier assigned.
generic.Exception handling path: Vulnerabilities with unresolved scoring disputes route to the Operational Resilience Lead.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Prioritisation is complete only when the ranked list is published for planning.
generic.Evidence location: Vulnerability register and heat map in Archer GRC and Power BI.

steps.title: Score each vulnerability on likelihood and severity
sop: Open each open vulnerability record in Archer GRC.
Score likelihood and severity using the approved scoring matrix.
Done when every open vulnerability has both scores entered.
verify: Recheck one scored vulnerability against the matrix definitions.
Pass when the score matches the matrix criteria for that vulnerability.

steps.title: Plot scored vulnerabilities on the resilience heat map
sop: Export scored vulnerabilities into the Power BI resilience heat map report.
Refresh the report to plot each vulnerability by likelihood and severity.
Done when all scored vulnerabilities appear on the heat map.
verify: Count the plotted points against the exported vulnerability count.
Pass when the two counts match exactly.

steps.title: Assign a priority tier to each vulnerability
sop: Read each vulnerability's position on the heat map.
Set the priority tier field to Critical, High, Medium or Low in the register.
Done when every scored vulnerability has a tier assigned.
verify: Spot-check a tier assignment against its heat map position.
Pass when the tier matches the expected heat map quadrant.

steps.title: Cross-check tier assignments against the prior period
sop: Compare each vulnerability's current tier to its prior-period tier.
Flag any vulnerability with a material tier change for review.
Done when all flagged rating changes are logged.
verify: Review the flagged list against the tier comparison output.
Pass when every material change is captured in the flagged list.

steps.title: Publish the ranked vulnerability list
sop: Sort the register by priority tier and likelihood/severity score.
Publish the ranked list to the resilience governance forum.
Done when the ranked list is published and accessible.
verify: Open the published list and confirm the sort order is correct.
Pass when Critical items appear ahead of lower tiers.

steps.title: Confirm the ranked list feeds remediation planning
sop: Share the published ranked list reference with the Operational Resilience Lead.
Confirm the list is the input used for the next remediation planning cycle.
Done when the Lead confirms receipt of the ranked list.
verify: Check for a confirmation reply or log entry from the Lead.
Pass when confirmation of receipt is recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: All vulnerabilities marked Closed in the register following prior remediation.
generic.In-scope period: Trailing 12-month period since each vulnerability's remediation closure.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each closed vulnerability shows an annual re-assessment date and reviewer.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of re-assessed vulnerabilities matches the closed-vulnerability population due this cycle.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Re-assessment scoring and control re-test results are dated in Archer GRC.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Vulnerabilities reopened due to residual risk drift are logged with the reopening reason.
generic.Test population: Sample of closed vulnerabilities due their annual re-assessment.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if every closed vulnerability shows a dated re-assessment within the last 12 months.
generic.Exception handling path: Vulnerabilities failing the control re-test are reopened and routed to remediation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Re-assessment is complete only when the annual summary is archived.
generic.Evidence location: Resilience evidence repository and vulnerability register in Archer GRC.

steps.title: Pull the prior-year vulnerability register
sop: Open Archer GRC and filter the register to vulnerabilities closed over 12 months ago.
Export the list of closed vulnerabilities due for annual re-assessment.
Done when the due-for-re-assessment list is confirmed.
verify: Check the exported list against the register's closed-status filter.
Pass when the list matches the filter count exactly.

steps.title: Re-score each remediated item's residual risk
sop: Reassess each closed vulnerability's residual risk after its implemented controls.
Enter the updated residual risk score into the register.
Done when every due vulnerability has an updated residual score.
verify: Recheck one residual score against the current control state.
Pass when the score reflects the control's current effectiveness.

steps.title: Re-test remediation actions closed in the prior 12 months
sop: Select the control implemented for each closed remediation action.
Re-test the control to confirm it remains effective.
Done when every re-tested control has a pass or fail outcome.
verify: Review the re-test evidence for a clear pass or fail result.
Pass when the outcome is documented and unambiguous.

steps.title: Record the annual re-assessment date and reviewer
sop: Confirm the re-assessment results for each vulnerability with the Analyst.
Enter the re-assessment date and reviewer name on each vulnerability record.
Done when every re-assessed vulnerability shows a date and reviewer.
verify: Open a sample record and confirm date and reviewer fields are populated.
Pass when both fields are present and the date is within 12 months.

steps.title: Reopen vulnerabilities where residual risk breaches tolerance
sop: Identify vulnerabilities where the re-scored residual risk exceeds impact tolerance.
Change the vulnerability status back to Open in the register.
Done when every tolerance-breaching item is reopened.
verify: Compare the reopened list against the residual risk re-score results.
Pass when every breaching item appears in the reopened list.

steps.title: Archive the annual re-assessment summary
sop: Compile the annual re-assessment results into a summary document.
Save the summary in the resilience evidence repository.
Done when the summary is archived and retrievable.
verify: Retrieve the archived summary and confirm it covers all due vulnerabilities.
Pass when the summary is complete and accessible in the repository.

generic.Defined scope/population: All important business services with a published service map in Confluence.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Newly identified vulnerabilities show a service map reference and dependency type.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of reviewed service maps matches the total important business service population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reviewed service map version and review date are recorded against the business service.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Service maps found out of date are logged and routed for republishing.
generic.Test population: Sample of important business service maps reviewed this cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if every reviewed service map yields a logged vulnerability or a no-findings note.
generic.Exception handling path: Concentration risks found in third-party dependencies route to the vendor register owner.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Review is complete only when every service map's dependency chain is walked end-to-end.
generic.Evidence location: Vulnerability register in Archer GRC, service maps in Confluence.

steps.title: Pull the current service map for each business service
sop: Open Confluence and locate the published service map for each important business service.
Confirm the map covers people, process, technology and third-party dependencies.
Done when all in-scope service maps are opened for review.
verify: Check each map's last-updated date against the review cycle window.
Pass when every map opened is the current published version.

steps.title: Walk the dependency chain to find single points of failure
sop: Trace the mapped dependency chain end-to-end for each business service.
Note any single point of failure or missing redundancy found.
Done when every dependency chain has been walked and notes captured.
verify: Review the notes for at least one finding or an explicit no-findings statement.
Pass when every walked chain has a documented outcome.

steps.title: Cross-reference third-party dependencies against the vendor register
sop: List the third-party dependencies shown on each service map.
Compare each against the vendor register for concentration risk.
Done when every third-party dependency has been cross-referenced.
verify: Spot-check one cross-reference against the vendor register entry.
Pass when the comparison result matches the vendor register data.

steps.title: Log newly identified vulnerabilities in the register
sop: Create a new entry in the resilience vulnerability register for each finding.
Reference the source service map against the new entry.
Done when every finding is logged with a service map reference.
verify: Open a logged entry and confirm the service map reference is present.
Pass when the reference matches the map the finding came from.

steps.title: Confirm the reviewed service map matches the latest published version
sop: Check the Confluence version history for the service map reviewed.
Confirm no newer version was published after the review started.
Done when version currency is confirmed for every reviewed map.
verify: Compare the review date to the map's last-published date.
Pass when the reviewed version is the latest as of the review date.

steps.title: Hand off logged vulnerabilities for scoring
sop: Notify the Operational Resilience Analyst that new vulnerabilities are logged.
Confirm the new entries are visible in the shared register view.
Done when the Analyst confirms receipt of the new entries.
verify: Check the register for the new entries' visibility to the Analyst team.
Pass when all logged entries appear in the shared view.

generic.Defined scope/population: All open remediation actions with a committed milestone date in the tracker.
generic.In-scope period: Current monthly resilience governance reporting cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every open remediation action shows status, percent complete and next milestone date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tracked action count matches the total open remediation action population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Status update date and evidence of progress are recorded against each action.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Amber and red actions are flagged with the owner chased and a response logged.
generic.Test population: Sample of open remediation actions due for status update this cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if every open action shows a current status and updated milestone where applicable.
generic.Exception handling path: Actions with no owner response are escalated per the resilience governance escalation path.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Tracking is complete only when the dashboard is published for the governance meeting.
generic.Evidence location: Remediation tracker in Archer GRC, dashboard in Power BI.

steps.title: Pull the current status of every open remediation action
sop: Open the remediation tracker in Archer GRC.
Export the status and milestone date for every open action.
Done when the current status list is exported.
verify: Check the export count against the tracker's open-action total.
Pass when the counts match exactly.

steps.title: Flag amber and red remediation actions
sop: Compare each action's due date to today's date and its started status.
Mark amber for due within two weeks and not started, red for overdue.
Done when every open action has an amber, red, or green flag.
verify: Spot-check one flagged action against the amber/red definition.
Pass when the flag matches the defined threshold rule.

steps.title: Chase action owners for updated status on amber and red items
sop: Identify the assigned owner for each amber or red action.
Request an updated status and evidence of progress from the owner.
Done when every amber or red item has a chase request logged.
verify: Check the tracker for a logged chase date against each amber/red item.
Pass when no amber or red item is missing a chase record.

steps.title: Update the milestone tracker with latest status
sop: Enter the owner's updated status and percent complete into the tracker.
Revise the milestone date where the owner has confirmed a change.
Done when every action's tracker entry reflects the latest update.
verify: Compare the tracker entry to the owner's reported update.
Pass when the entry matches what the owner reported.

steps.title: Publish the remediation progress dashboard
sop: Refresh the Power BI remediation progress dashboard from the updated tracker.
Publish the dashboard ahead of the monthly governance meeting.
Done when the dashboard is published and accessible.
verify: Open the published dashboard and confirm it reflects the latest tracker data.
Pass when dashboard figures match the tracker as of publish time.

steps.title: Confirm the dashboard with the Business Continuity Manager
sop: Review the published dashboard ahead of the governance meeting.
Confirm amber/red items and their chase status are accurately shown.
Done when the Manager confirms the dashboard is accurate.
verify: Cross-check a sample amber/red item on the dashboard against the tracker.
Pass when the dashboard entry matches the tracker record.

generic.Defined scope/population: All vulnerabilities with a completed remediation action awaiting register closure.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Closed vulnerability shows status, closure date, reviewer and updated residual risk score.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of closed entries matches the number of remediations confirmed complete.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Closure evidence and validation date are attached and timestamped on the record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Vulnerabilities lacking valid closure evidence remain open with the gap logged.
generic.Test population: Sample of vulnerabilities with a completed remediation action this cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if every closed vulnerability has evidence, closure date and reviewer recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Incomplete closure evidence routes back to the remediation action owner.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Update is complete only when the closed vulnerability is off the active backlog view.
generic.Evidence location: Vulnerability register and closure evidence in Archer GRC.

steps.title: Confirm closure evidence is attached to the vulnerability record
sop: Open the vulnerability record for the completed remediation action.
Confirm the control test result and implementation sign-off are attached.
Done when closure evidence is confirmed present.
verify: Open the attachment and confirm it shows a pass result and sign-off.
Pass when both the test result and sign-off are present and legible.

steps.title: Re-score residual risk after remediation
sop: Assess the vulnerability's residual risk now that remediation is implemented.
Update the priority tier to reflect the new residual risk score.
Done when the residual score and tier are both updated.
verify: Recheck the new score against the post-remediation control state.
Pass when the score reflects the implemented control accurately.

steps.title: Change the vulnerability status to Closed
sop: Confirm the closure evidence has been validated as sufficient.
Change the status field from Open or In Remediation to Closed.
Done when the status field shows Closed.
verify: Open the record and confirm the status field reads Closed.
Pass when the status matches the validated closure evidence.

steps.title: Record the closure date and validating reviewer
sop: Enter today's date as the closure date on the register entry.
Enter the name of the reviewer who validated the closure evidence.
Done when both fields are recorded on the entry.
verify: Open the entry and confirm closure date and reviewer are both present.
Pass when the reviewer name matches who validated the evidence.

steps.title: Remove the closed vulnerability from the active backlog view
sop: Open the active remediation backlog view in Archer GRC.
Confirm the newly closed vulnerability no longer appears in the view.
Done when the backlog view excludes the closed vulnerability.
verify: Search the backlog view for the closed vulnerability's ID.
Pass when the closed vulnerability does not appear in the search.

steps.title: Notify the Business Continuity Analyst of closure
sop: Send a closure notification referencing the vulnerability ID and closure date.
Confirm the Business Continuity Analyst acknowledges the closure.
Done when acknowledgement is received and logged.
verify: Check for a logged acknowledgement against the closure notification.
Pass when acknowledgement is recorded with a date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All scored vulnerabilities lacking an assigned remediation action in the current period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every scored vulnerability without a completed remediation appears in the backlog with a target quarter.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Backlog entry count matches the number of scored vulnerabilities lacking a remediation action.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Backlog ranking and publication date are recorded in the resilience governance forum record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Vulnerabilities that cannot be scheduled this period are logged with the capacity constraint reason.
generic.Test population: Sample of unscheduled vulnerabilities eligible for the current backlog ranking.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if every eligible vulnerability appears in the backlog with a priority tier and target quarter.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed rankings route back to the Operational Resilience Analyst for re-scoring.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Prioritisation is complete only when the ranked backlog is published to governance.
generic.Evidence location: Remediation backlog in Archer GRC, capacity view in Power BI.

steps.title: Pull vulnerabilities lacking an assigned remediation action
sop: Open Archer GRC and filter scored vulnerabilities with no remediation action assigned.
Export the unscheduled vulnerability list.
Done when the unscheduled list is confirmed against the register.
verify: Check the exported count against the register's no-action filter.
Pass when the counts match exactly.

steps.title: Check remediation capacity for the period
sop: Open the Power BI capacity view for the current remediation period.
Note the available remediation capacity by team and quarter.
Done when available capacity is confirmed for ranking.
verify: Cross-check the capacity figure against the resourcing plan.
Pass when the capacity figure is current and matches the resourcing plan.

steps.title: Rank unscheduled vulnerabilities into the backlog
sop: Order the unscheduled vulnerabilities by priority tier and available capacity.
Enter the ranked position into the remediation backlog in Archer GRC.
Done when every unscheduled vulnerability has a backlog rank.
verify: Spot-check one ranked item against its priority tier.
Pass when higher-tier items rank ahead of lower-tier items.

steps.title: Assign a target remediation quarter to each backlog item
sop: Match each ranked item to a remediation window based on capacity and priority.
Enter the target quarter into the backlog entry.
Done when every backlog item has a target quarter assigned.
verify: Confirm the assigned quarter does not exceed the team's available capacity.
Pass when quarter assignments stay within capacity limits.

steps.title: Obtain agreement on the backlog ranking before publication
sop: Circulate the ranked backlog for review and agreement per the resilience governance process.
Incorporate any agreed changes to the ranking or target quarter.
Done when the ranking is confirmed agreed and finalised.
verify: Check for a recorded agreement confirmation against the finalised backlog.
Pass when agreement is confirmed before publication.

steps.title: Publish the ranked remediation backlog to the governance forum
sop: Finalise the agreed backlog document.
Publish it to the resilience governance forum for the period.
Done when the backlog is published and accessible to governance.
verify: Open the published backlog and confirm it matches the agreed ranking.
Pass when the published version reflects the final agreed ranking.

generic.Defined scope/population: All draft vulnerability findings pending control owner review this cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every finding shows control owner acceptance or a logged, adjudicated dispute.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Validated finding count matches the total draft findings distributed for review.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Control owner response and adjudication decision are dated in Archer GRC or AuditBoard.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Contested findings are logged with the control owner's rationale and adjudication outcome.
generic.Test population: Sample of draft findings distributed to control owners this cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if every finding has an acceptance or an adjudicated dispute recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Findings without a response within the window escalate to the Operational Resilience Lead.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validation is complete only when the findings list is locked for prioritisation.
generic.Evidence location: Findings register in AuditBoard, adjudication record in Archer GRC.

steps.title: Distribute draft vulnerability findings to control owners
sop: Identify the named control owner for each affected business service in AuditBoard.
Send the draft finding to each control owner for review.
Done when every draft finding is distributed to its control owner.
verify: Check the distribution log for a sent record against every draft finding.
Pass when every finding shows a distribution record.

steps.title: Confirm control owner review within the response window
sop: Track control owner responses against the defined response window.
Confirm each finding shows either acceptance or contest.
Done when every distributed finding has a response recorded.
verify: Check response timestamps against the response window deadline.
Pass when every finding has a response logged within or flagged past the window.

steps.title: Record contested findings and route for adjudication
sop: Capture the control owner's rationale for contesting the finding.
Route the contested finding to the Operational Resilience Lead for adjudication.
Done when every contested finding is routed with rationale attached.
verify: Open a contested finding and confirm the rationale and routing are present.
Pass when both the rationale and routing status are recorded.

steps.title: Adjudicate contested findings
sop: Review the control owner's rationale for each contested finding in Archer GRC.
Record the adjudication decision to uphold, amend or withdraw the finding.
Done when every contested finding has an adjudication decision.
verify: Check that each contested finding shows a final adjudication outcome.
Pass when the outcome is one of uphold, amend or withdraw.

steps.title: Assign remediation accountability for validated findings
sop: Identify the named owner responsible for remediating each validated finding.
Enter the accountable owner against the finding record.
Done when every validated finding has an assigned remediation owner.
verify: Open a sample validated finding and confirm an owner name is recorded.
Pass when the owner field is populated for all validated findings.

steps.title: Lock the validated findings list
sop: Confirm every finding shows acceptance or adjudicated disposition and an assigned owner.
Set the findings list status to locked in AuditBoard.
Done when the list is locked and ready for prioritisation.
verify: Attempt to edit a locked finding and confirm editing is blocked.
Pass when the list is locked and no unresolved findings remain.

generic.Defined scope/population: All mapped dependencies for important business services requiring a tolerance assessment.
generic.In-scope period: Current dependency assessment cycle following service mapping.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each important business service dependency shows a plausible-disruption assessment against tolerance.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assessed dependency count matches the total mapped dependency population.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Disruption scenario modelling and gap rationale are dated on the business service entry.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Dependencies unable to be modelled are logged with the reason and follow-up owner.
generic.Test population: Sample of mapped dependencies assessed this cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if every dependency has a modelled disruption outcome against its tolerance.
generic.Exception handling path: Flagged resilience gaps hand off to vulnerability identification for formal logging.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment is complete only when every dependency has a modelled outcome recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Business service entries and dependency assessments in Archer GRC.

steps.title: Pull the mapped dependency list for each business service
sop: Open the service map for each important business service in Archer GRC.
Extract the full list of mapped dependencies.
Done when the dependency list is confirmed for all in-scope services.
verify: Check the extracted list against the service map's dependency count.
Pass when the counts match for every service.

steps.title: Model plausible disruption duration for each dependency
sop: Define a plausible disruption scenario for each mapped dependency.
Estimate the disruption duration under that scenario.
Done when every dependency has a modelled disruption duration.
verify: Recheck one modelled duration against the scenario assumptions used.
Pass when the duration is consistent with the stated assumptions.

steps.title: Compare modelled disruption against the service's impact tolerance
sop: Compare each dependency's modelled disruption duration to its service's tolerance threshold.
Note whether the disruption would breach the threshold.
Done when every dependency has a tolerance comparison result.
verify: Spot-check a comparison result against the raw duration and threshold figures.
Pass when the result correctly reflects the comparison.

steps.title: Flag dependencies that breach impact tolerance as resilience gaps
sop: Mark any dependency whose modelled disruption breaches tolerance as a resilience gap.
Record the flag on the business service entry.
Done when every breaching dependency is flagged as a gap.
verify: Confirm the flagged gaps match the breaching comparison results.
Pass when no breaching dependency is left unflagged.

steps.title: Record the gap rationale against the business service entry
sop: Document the affected dependency, scenario and rationale for each flagged gap.
Attach the rationale to the business service entry in Archer GRC.
Done when every flagged gap has a documented rationale.
verify: Open a flagged gap and confirm the rationale references the correct dependency.
Pass when the rationale is complete and attached.

steps.title: Hand off flagged gaps for formal vulnerability logging
sop: Compile the list of flagged resilience gaps ready for handoff.
Send the list to the vulnerability identification step for formal register entry.
Done when every flagged gap is confirmed logged as a vulnerability.
verify: Check the vulnerability register for a new entry against each handed-off gap.
Pass when every flagged gap has a corresponding register entry.

generic.Defined scope/population: All important business services with a proposed impact tolerance pending owner confirmation.

steps.title: Circulate proposed impact tolerances to service owners

Send the proposed impact tolerance metric and threshold to each owner via SharePoint.

steps.title: Capture service owner confirmation or requested adjustment

Enter the response against the corresponding tolerance record in Archer GRC.

verify: Open a tolerance record and confirm a response is logged.

steps.title: Resolve disputed thresholds with the Enterprise Risk Manager
sop: Review each disputed threshold and the service owner's adjustment request.
Agree a final threshold with the service owner before finalising.
Done when every disputed threshold has a resolved final value.
verify: Check the resolved threshold against the documented agreement.

steps.title: Record the confirmation date and confirming owner
sop: Enter the confirmation date and the confirming service owner's name on the tolerance entry.
Save the entry in Archer GRC.
Done when every tolerance entry shows a date and confirming owner.

steps.title: Lock confirmed impact tolerances as the testing baseline
sop: Confirm every important business service has a finalised, confirmed tolerance.
Set the tolerance register to locked for the next scenario-testing cycle.
